name: Vow of Dawn ignores periodic damage from Hammer of Kings (#9784, #9787)
contract: Vow of Dawn (803491) reads 'Direct ability damage or healing generates 1 Solar Power and bounces
to $803492s1 additional nearby targets with less value per target struck.' Hammer of Kings (804751)
applies SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 23, amplitude 3000) which casts 804752 -- a plain
SCHOOL_DAMAGE -- on every tick. AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellAuraTick casts that trigger
with TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK, so the resulting proc arrives with PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_NEG
and no PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC. Before the fix AscensionSunClericEvents::Check() therefore computed
direct == true for those ticks and the Vow fired: the cleric gained Solar Power per tick and the tick
bounced 803493 onto nearby enemies, contradicting the tooltip. Check() now also treats a spell whose
GetTriggeredByAuraSpellInfo() carries a periodic-trigger aura as periodic, except for Sunslam's own
periodic weapon-damage tick which #9148 requires to fulfil the Vow. With Vow of Dawn active and only
Hammer of Kings ticking, Solar Power must not rise and no 803493 may land.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Vow of Dawn is active on the caster
Vow of Dawn and Hammer of Kings share StartRecoveryCategory 133 (1000 ms); let that GCD clear
Record Solar Power before Hammer of Kings starts ticking
Hammer of Kings lasts 12 s and ticks every 3 s; wait past the whole duration so every tick resolves
Hammer of Kings periodic ticks deal damage to the nearby enemy
Periodic damage must not bounce Vow of Dawn onto nearby enemies
Periodic damage must not bounce Vow of Dawn onto the original target
Periodic damage must not generate Solar Power
